comments: Raluca is a great host and her place is well kept, decorated and functional.

Christopher’s place was super clean and always super quiet! Very very responsive! Went as far as to offer coffee in the morning and made sure that I knew how to enter and exit the property! The only downside if ANY was the HILL it’s on! Would definitely recommend staying!

We very much enjoyed our stayed at the Simply Brooklyn Apt #4. The host is Andre but Jamal, who lives in the building, was the person who tended to us. He was always available and eager to help in whatever way possible. The apt was spacious and they provided a queen air mattress as well as set it up for me in the living room. The main areas of the apt were very clean, though some areas needed a deeper cleaning. The kitchen met our basic needs and Jamal was quick to provide a can opener and a few extra dish cloths upon request. He also told us if there is anything else we need we simply have to ask.
We did have a rough start getting in to the building. Btw, the building is a little sketchy looking from the outside, but the two apartments, #3 and #4 are nice. There was no lock box and I was told the front door would be unlocked but it wasn’t. We stood outside in the cold for about 20 minutes while we tried to make contact. Eventually Jamal came.

Such wonderful hosts. Super helpful and super responsive. Really appreciated the hospitality, and the clean and affordable room. It was very close to public transportation. I enjoyed my stay at this location and the hosts were awesome.
El lugar contaba con todo lo necesario
Alicia’s place was quiet and cozy for the time we spent there! Close to LaGuardia which is very nice! Would stay again anytime!!!

It was overall a nice stay, very intimate and private. The place looked even better than the pictures and it was cozy. My boyfriend was really surprised when he seen the place. It was a surprise for our anniversary so, the fact he was surprised and pleased just goes to show how beautiful the place was. The only downsides was the many ants I know this time of year pest can be hard to manage but, the fact I brought home ants with me in my shower luggage is a little ridiculous. I also feel like the jacuzzi could’ve been cleaner we had to fill it up and empty it a few times because it kept developing this tan foamy substance around the sides.
nice and clean place
Cindy was a pleasant to do business with friendly responses and just a great person
Wonderful locations, nice, clean room, comfortable bed

Our stay at Eric & Jen’s place was really good. The house was clean and comfortable, and the location was convenient for getting around. Everything went smoothly during our stay. Thanks for having us!
Really enjoyed my stay in this quiet home and neighborhood. Hosts were welcoming, communicative, and accommodating. Thank you!!
Good neighborhood, good space. Easy bus connections to the ferry.
Perfect spot for a solo traveler
Had a wonderful stay here -- the space was adorable and well-kept. I could walk to everything, and it was a quiet, beautiful street.
Warm and good place. Silvia is Great
Fantastic place to stay with walking distance to L line but peaceful surroundings, great comfortable home base for a busy weekend!
This was a wonderful stay. She was one of the best air bnb hosts I've ever had.
Colleen is a great host, she is so helpful and kind. Her place feels just like home and she is always willing to answer any questions you have about getting around. 10/10 recommend.
We had a great time. The house was clean and tidy. The beds were comfortable.

Duane was a great host to my family, especially our pup! The place is neat and has all amenities. Duane gave us local recommendations and was very easy to reach. We would definitely come back when in the area.
I enjoyed staying here. It is in a peaceful neighborhood and the hosts are on the property. They are very responsive and helpful. I felt right at home.
Good place for the price

Hotel staff Tristan was amazing! She went above and beyond. The hotel had no hot water during my stay, I was told the hotel was offering a discount for the inconvenience, however our host provided nothing more than “we will look into it” Never heard anything back. I’m sure he enjoyed his hot water.
Neil made check and check out super easy and the house is great. Very clean and it’s exactly as advertised.
I’ve stayed at this lovely Airbnb. I highly recommend, 10/10. The host is lovely and really friendly, and it’s right outside a bus stop which connects you to other areas in the city. ☺️

Had a lovely stay and would recommend staying here to anyone. The room is very tasteful and comfortable, the bathroom is clean and has everything you need, communication was good (super easy and friendly) and it’s great to stay in Williamsburg when visiting NYC. It has such a good atmosphere and everything you need (and more!) nearby and you’re just one metro ride away from manhattan. I would love to stay here again!
I absolutely loved it. Very clean, very pristine, very cozy. Would def stay here again!

I have no notes for Elida’s place. If you are considering taking a chance on a new listing DO IT! She communicates with kindness and is just a really thoughtful person. I would liken this accommodation to a hotel with a shared bathroom. Parking was easy. Everything is sanitary, there were shoe covers and slippers available. Very nice toiletries packages with loofahs, soap, toothbrush&paste you name it. The kitchen is equipped with so many generous offerings for us to enjoy which is truly appreciated from water, fresh fruit, pastries and chips. A few favorite things: the bathroom had dr Bronner’s soap, the closet space is huge and the luggage stand is a nice touch. I will definitely be staying here again. Thank you for a wonderful accommodation!
Beautiful furnishings and renovations. Excellent location, close to Central Park. Inside was clean and well maintained. Super friendly owner.

A nice place to stay in Staten Island, a short drive from the Staten Island Ferry.  A nicely appointed, private, apartment attached to a lovely home. A lovely modern layout with hardwood floors, large tv, modern full bath with glass shower enclosure hand spray head, standup shower, great water pressure. The private entrance was nice for our late arrival. I appreciated the checkout time, well beyond most. Look forward to coming back to see another show at the St George Theater (exquisite!!) and we’ll be sure to stay here again.
Great host, great air bnb!
Amazing space & location, hope to be able to stay there again!!

When I checked-in, Silvia was already there, making sure everything was ready for my stay. That's how proactive she is as a host. Her presence boldly said, "SHE CARES." I enjoyed that support and care throughout my stay at her Airbnb.
Silvia provided a monitor for me to do my remote work and made sure everything was in pristine and working condition. The space was clean and cozy. I enjoyed having a full kitchen and nearby grocery store (Gourmet Island - visit them while you are there) to walk to. There is also coffee shops and a great pizzeria (shout out to Rustic Pizza!) Wherever I couldn't walk to, Uber Eats got me what I wanted within a half hour. Even my rides to the ferry and visits to see my mother were barely 25 minutes from the space. Simply put - along with the comfort of this Airbnb was plenty of convenience.
I give a big thanks to Silvia for providing this refuge for me when I really needed it. If I come back to Staten Island, I hope this space will be available!
He was very pleasant. Very clean and comfy place, I highly recommend.
Súper
I enjoyed my stay at Chris’s. It was just what was needed for our visit to the Bronx for a baseball game at Yankee stadium. It was a short walk to the stadium and basic shopping needs.

Der Aufenthalt war durchgehend angenehm. Alles verlief problemlos und Leon war jederzeit erreichbar und hat sich immer erkundigt und seine Hilfe angeboten.
Sehr sauber, jederzeit wieder!
Great experience
Place is great, clean and spacious. Had all the amenities listed and location is convenient as well. 100% recommend
Right in the thick of NYC life!

It was very clear that Cynthia put a lot of effort into keeping her guest space clean, comfortable and welcoming.
It was an added bonus to have separate bathroom facilities and a private entrance during my stay. That was not expected and really appreciated. I would recommend this lovely, spacious and comfortable guest room to anyone visiting New York.
Thank you for your hospitality Cynthia.
Hotel na times, bom pra vida noturna!

Buen alojamiento, a pocos minutos en metro de las zonas turísticas de Manhattan. Aunque la zona no es la más bonita, se siente tranquila y es fácil moverse desde ahí a otras partes. Nos sorprendió gratamente que incluyeran el desayuno. También nos prestaron paraguas para llevar a nuestro recorrido.
La habitación tenía todo y estaba muy limpia y organizada.

My husband and I had such a lovely stay at Eric and Jen’s Airbnb. So cozy! It was spotless, modern kitchen, beautiful bathroom and comfortable bed. Eric answered any questions I had quickly and will highly recommend their Airbnb. We hope to use them again in the future.
C and B
Miss Nadege was very sweet , she helped out with any problem I needed , very responsive even at the most oddest times . I’d def stay here again

Escobar’s place was the perfect haven for my summer in NYC. The location is completely unbeatable, the place is HUGE with tons of natural light, and they were very responsive when I needed support on anything. Was genuinely sad when I left!
Everything was great here, the food, the staff, and the room.
I enjoyed my stay at Angels apartment.
It was a great stay in New York City. Would recommend!

You get what you paid for. For a group of 7, it is expensive to get an accomodation in NY.
It is not the best, but if you are looking for a budget place to stay, this is the right one for you.
The place was clean, my only comment is the towels, it smells a little bit.
The apartment was very cute for a weekend getaway. Erik & Jen were very helpful & accommodating. The apartment was exactly very cozy and welcoming would definitely book again
Would definitely return excellent hosts highly recommend
Super responsive and such a beautiful space. You can’t go wrong.
I enjoyed my stay. It was very easy and flexible to check in. Great spot in the city. Would go back!
Perfect space for a couple!  Close to transportation and easy to walk to restaurants.

This space was perfect for my aunt and I for a weekend in NYC. Christian went above and beyond as a host. He was communicative (even late at night) and provided excellent customer service. You can tell he cares about providing a good experience, not just a place to sleep.
The ferry is easily accessible and the apartment was clean, uncluttered, and had everything we needed. It's just as pictured. The unit is above a barbershop and has some street parking. It's on the second floor and there's a unit above it, so of course you'll hear the neighbors walking around, etc, but with the noise machine Christian provides, it didn't bother us. We would absolutely consider booking again for our next trip and recommend it to others.
PLEASE NOTE: Something I missed when I looked at the listing is that it's a shared kitchen/dining/living room, so the only private space is the bedroom and bathroom. Just good to know before you go (it's clearly listed, I just missed it).
good

As expected NY was very expensive and the rental of this apartment was by far the best value for money element of my trip. It is a very good size in a quiet, safe location ,  with excellent proximity to the Ferry which I used all the time,  I also used the N train line consistently from 30Ave station. I got Ubers from and to the apartment, which were always super efficient and from TimesSquare it ranged from $30-55 which was brilliant and very reasonable . As I stayed for so long I used a launderette for washing and it is a 10-15 minute walk . All in all, this was a brilliant find and I was very happy there. Astoria is very pleasant , safe, and there are some outstanding restaurants in Ditmars Blvd .
Felt just at home Seyi is a wonderful host .
The room was very nice and spacious i liked it!
The host was responsive and dealt with any questions and concerns I had.
Great stay in a very clean apartment in a great location to go and explore New York!

Florrie's place is located in a friendly and safe neighborhood. The space itself is nice, spacious, and clean with almost everything you'd need - no microwave but there is an electric stove that we used to warm up some leftovers on. It is still the city so you'll hear noise from cars and people outside - something to consider if you're a light sleeper. There's a parking structure nearby if you don't want to deal with street parking. Florrie is super friendly and communicative, making sure we were comfortable during our stay. We had a great time exploring Brooklyn and totally recommend this place.

El alojamiento fue muy bueno, pequeño y acogedor. Estaba limpio, el anfitrión siempre respondía mis dudas, muy buena comunicación.  Lo único que mejoraría es que parecía que corría viento a través de la ventana y al dormir hacía sentir frio, había mucha electricidad estática y no había calefacción para graduar. La ubicación fue buena, esta cerca de estaciones del subway.
Elen’s place as a great stay for our weekend in Ridgewood - flexibility for a late check out was appreciated!
Thank you for the accommodations! Wish you the very best!
Enjoyed the experience and the reception was really nice !
Jest to fajne miejsce czysto bardzo mili gospodarze Nasz pobyt z kolei już drugi w tym miejscu i napewno jeszcze będziemy korzystać .polecamy

Duane provided a space that was peaceful, warm, secluded and yet accessible.
He was a responsive host - giving me an extra monitor on one of his tables for remote working, with all of the necessary cables. I was able to see a cherished, sick family member during the day and work on my projects at night.
The cleanliness and decor of the bathroom invited me to get away from the strong emotional impact of my short stay.
I didn't meet Duane in person but I definitely connected with him in spirit. His friendly and positive demeanor permeated the space, saying and proving confidently, "I got you, Friend."
I hope to stay with Duane again!

Stayed for 3 nights in Chinatown. The room was very clean and the bed was comfy, and water hot. We had everything we needed. We loved being one block from the N train which took us everywhere. Would stay again.
Gracias por el servicio

Great location. Spacious unit. Unfortunately the shower was broken during our stay and we had to ask the staff several times over the course of our stay to come up and fix it. It was finally fixed on our last night but it was a bit late for our large group at that point

Had a great stay at Aaron’s apartment. Apartment was clean and spacious and perfect for our needs. Aaron communicated well when we need him.
Only fault we had was it’s further out of town than we anticipated but even then we were only a 5 minute walk and 30 minute ride on the Subway from central Manhattan. Would thoroughly recommend.

La habitación fue ideal y justo lo que necesitaba. El baño y la sala de estar son compartidos, al igual que un microondas y un mini refrigerador.  Si vas a a visitar la ciudad es el mejor lugar para ahorrar y además disfrutar de la vista que da el viaje gratis en ferry. La zona es tranquila y muy bien ubicada. Quedan cerca paradas de camiones, súper mercados, restaurantes, básicamente todo lo que necesitas. John me recibió muy amablemente y estuvo al pendiente todo el viaje. 100% regresaría y recomiendo este lugar. ✨🙌🏻

Great place to stay for a family. Windsor terrace is an entertaining neighborhood with the loveliest people and restaurants to suit any meal. There’s an amazing cafe around the corner, 2 min walk from the subway, 2 mins from Prospect Park. We benefitted from local street parties which gave us the privilege to meet locals who are mostly families or older generations. There’s a supermarket/pharmacy/bagel place/bars/cafes one block away and a top notch cinema (nite hawk) too.
Nice
Me gusto, es literalmente el cuarto que ofrecen
Beware that when you arrive they tack on a hotel fee. I didn’t see that in the listing
My stay was great!
Very much as described and seen in the pictures.  It was a much quieter place than other places I have stayed in the Bronx.  Was great to find a place that fit my family for the weekend.
Good

A Ana é uma boa anfitriã, não tenho o que reclamar. As pessoas que vão usar metro é bom se informar sobre obras que estão progredindo lentamente na linha 7, no futuro vai melhorar, mas agora complicam um pouco.

Hans was a lovely host! Very responsive and easy to get along with. If you don’t mind the commute time to New York proper it’s a great fit, and the free ferry ride is enjoyable. Overall it was a very nice space with a good feel.
Alles war in Ordnung.

We enjoyed our stay at Monifa's. The place was charming, spacious and clean and very conventiantly located. There was a glitsch however getting into the building. The problem was the hosts were travelling and had neglected to give us the contact info for the substitute host.
Once he arrived the issue was quickly resolved and when our hosts returned home they offered us a partial refund for the inconvenience. They were considerate and accomodating and we would definitely visit there again in the future.
great place to stay for a weekend getaway or staycation!
Amazing place to stay. Great host!!!
Ho trovato una coppia molto gentile che ha soddisfatto le mie esigenze.Era come essere a casa.Consiglio le persone e il posto

Excellent hotel in a great location
We had one single problem: it took us 4 hours to check-in
Other than that, it has been a very good experience

Good location, about 7 minute walk to train station and about 45 min train ride to Manhattan. Ola was out of town, and his cousin was in charge of the airbnb which is why I think the cleanliness was subpar. The toilet had old urine around the base and smelly microfiber hand towel that we didn't touch our entire 4 day stay. Our room was ok, but the bed.... we found chips and hair under the covers. The sheets clearly had not been washed. Our feet turned black and were covered in dirt and hair. For the price, we dealt with it, and we knew Ola was out of town. I think if he was there the Airbnb would've been a lot cleaner based on other reviews. We felt safe and it was affordable, so we give it 4/5 overall.
the place was amazing 👏.  Host was very responsive. I definitely recommend and will definitely stay there again.
Miguel is a great host. I look forward to the next time I visit. I definitely plan on staying at Miguel’s again.
Enjoyed my stay.
The room was not the room I booked on Airbnb, it was a totally different room. The photos was misleading.
Vivian was very responsive and ensured a comfortable and safe stay. The long term stay was excellent for our work in the area. Thank you!!
It was an awesome room

I can't speak highly enough about my recent stay. My daughter was due to have a baby when the snow storm hit NYC. Matt was very thoughtful and provided a few extra's due to the weather conditions. He made sure I was taken care of and comfortable. The place itself is cozy, clean and super cute. This is my go to in Brooklyn. I love it.
Great host !
This hotel had everything I needed. Great location and the staff were approachable and helpful

Tivemos uma experiência excelente com a Anna!
Ela foi uma anfitriã muito atenciosa, sempre respondendo rapidamente às nossas mensagens e garantindo que nos sentíssemos à vontade durante toda a estadia.
A casa estava limpa, é muito confortável e tem uma boa localização, a poucos minutos do metrô, facilitando o acesso a Manhattan e Downtown Brooklyn.
Com certeza recomendamos para quem procura conforto, privacidade e praticidade. Voltaríamos sem pensar duas vezes! ⭐️

My stay at the Han brothers was 10/10. Han was super helpful and flexible with my check-in times, and was very understanding when they ended up changing last minute.
The apartment was great, super short walk from a few subway stations, very clean and well equipped!
While I spent a lot of time outside, I did have the chance to chitchat with both Han and his brother, and they were lovely and very interesting. It always felt very comfortable and relaxed!
The coffee was also very appreciated 😁
I would definitely come back, thank you again for your help on the last day when I struggled with my packing 😂
Die Unterkunft war super und wie beschrieben! wir haben uns wohl gefühlt!
I felt relax and stay comfortable because of Adam's hospitality for the first time to visit NY. This area is safe and easy to buy foods and daily necessities!

I'd highly recommend this stay in the Brooklyn area! The spot was only a few minute walk from both the bus and the subway, Wayne and Lucelia were kind and responsive and offered clear and detailed instructions for check-in! The unit has a small kitchen which is perfect, and the space was spotless! very easy to feel at home here and I'd absolutely return again

The house is in a very safe and quiet neighborhood. The bus stop is 2 mins away. Bedroom where I stayed was very nice and clean and had everything I needed in it. Kitchen wasn’t super clean and bathroom, while it was clean, smelled weird. The host was super friendly and communicative and let me arrive later than anticipated. I’d definitely stay again for short term.

Our visit was amazing! The room was clean and the check in was super smooth. You could not hear the sounds of the city at all from inside! We were able to leave our luggage in the office for several hours after check out without an extra charge! Everyone was super kind and we felt very safe! We will definitely stay again!
Jamie was both hospitable and responsive during my stay. The place was clean, quiet, and very accessible to Midtown. I wouldn't hesitate staying there again. Highly recommended.

I absolutely loved my month-long stay at Calle and Amir’s thoughtfully designed place. They’ve really struck the perfect balance of lived-in comfort without feeling like you’re in a stranger’s space. The location couldn’t be more ideal for exploring Williamsburg and easily accessing lower Manhattan, and it was the perfect retreat to return to after a busy day in the city. The hosts were quick to assist with any questions, even over the holidays. I hope to return soon! Thank you so much :)
Accommodation was exactly what we needed and in a very good central Chinatown location. The host was very responsive and accommodating. Many thanks!
Excellent spot for one person

The place was exactly as described. It was so convenient to walk to the start of the NY marathon. The host was super friendly. They wished my partner good luck with the marathon several times thru text. They also left treats that were helpful for the marathon; electrolytes power, hand warmers, bottled water, etc. Such a nice jester. The house is about 3 miles from the Staten Island ferry; but there is a bus that will get you there. Overall, a great stay.
住的还是很舒服的~

Simplemente fue un recibimiento muy caluroso nos se times como en casa agradecidos con esta hermosa pareja muchas bendiciones .
Super recomendada …

Trato inhumano.
Hemos estado 3 adultos y 1 niño durante 7 días.
Al 4 día el niño 🤢 enfermó con fiebre y vomitó en las sábanas. Intenté hablar con la recepcionista que puso interés 0 para cambiar las sábanas, ( yo las cambiaba) y me dijo que era imposible. Después de ser pesada con que no podríamos dormir con la habitación vomitada, llamó a Elisa y esta le informó que tenía que pagar 76$por el cambio de sábanas. ( pero si comprar unas sábanas es más barato 😅).
No conozco a nadie con menos empatía que esta persona. Un asco, la verdad, gracias por nada.
Muy buena ubicación, ubicado a 5 min de la estación del metro para Central Park y Times Square, excelente para ir y venir a esa zona. Excelente comunicación por parte de Kyoko
molto vicino alla subway, appartamento spazioso, abbiamo vissuto il vero spirito di Manhattan e del Bronx!
My stay was great! Peter was very responsive and provided me with good recommendations for activities and restaurants in the area. I would definitely stay again when I travel to NYC.

The room was super neat and clean. There is a bathroom in the room which is very convenient. Everything was organized and there was plenty of room and everything worked smoothly. There is a/c and heat. The host, Ola, responded quickly and efficiently and attended to all our questions. This was a very pleasant experience and would recommend it to anyone.
The accommodation was as described. It is conveniently located near the train station.
Attentive host, close to subway!
A few welcome groceries were a thoughtful touch and perfect after a long flight.

I would truly thank Stephanie for hosting me in a such beautiful and cleaning space. Everything was matched with the description and the host will always support you and answer all your questions. I enjoyed the location, you can reach the ferry by walking and the bus goes every 5 minutes and it takes for 5 minutes to reach the ferry station. The district is calm and safety even if you find out in a web otherwise. I was walking from ferry to the house at deeply night and it felt good. If I need to go to the NYC again I will definitely choose this spot. Thank you for hosting me!
Emily responded quickly to concerns but due to the  shower but unfortunately I will not be back to the Airbnb.
Excellent location, nice modern apartment. Highly recommend and would stay again!

Nos encantó el departamento, todo estaba impecablemente limpio y ordenado. La cama era muy cómoda y nos sentimos como en casa. Peter fue sumamente amable y nos brindó buenas recomendaciones sobre lugares a donde ir y la zona. Volveríamos a quedarnos sin duda alguna.
Good and clean
Excelente servicio, muy buena atención, el lugar muy limpio, un área muy tranquila, me quedé con mi esposa y a ella le encantó!
The stay was very comfortable and it had all the amenities as described. its in a  very accessible location.  the host was proactively taking care of all needs as well
Worth the penny. It’s peaceful and walkable distance to subway.

This was my third time staying at this wonderful Airbnb, and as always, everything was perfect. This was my husband’s first time staying here with me, and he said it was his favorite Airbnb he’s ever been to. The space is quiet, peaceful, and so very relaxing. Thomas is always incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with. Thomas and Coy also added some thoughtful touches to welcome us back, which made the stay even more special. This truly feels like my home away from home—I can’t wait to come back again in December!
i was able to check in early and they were very responsive! beautiful area right by central park.

Yakima’s place is fine for the price! If you are looking for some where affordable to stay then this option is fine. Very basic, clean and a close walk to the subway. The only thing to be mindful of is if you have any back problems or a  bigger person, the mattresses are not great (they are pretty worn down, you can feel some of the springs), but good value for what it is.

We stayed here for a week and it was a great fit for a couple. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is very convenient—close to everything we needed—and street parking in the area was readily available. Silvia greeted us upon arrival and made check-in easy. We would absolutely stay here again when we’re back in Staten Island.

Kaz and the team offer an exceptional air bnb experience. I would highly recommend booking a long term stay in NY with their team. The space is really comfortable and is pristine clean and super convenient to public transportation. There’s a terrific 24/7 deli and brand new laundromat close by 2-3 minute walk) which is great. Check in and all directions are super clear.  Any questions I had were answered promptly. Every aspect of my stay was wonderful.! Thank you Kaz and team!
Rita es una gran anfitriona, te hace sentir como en casa; siempre estaba atenta a preguntas y nos sugería actividades.
Good

Great Airbnb location! Miguel and Daniela were great hosts! They were responsive, provided a welcoming environment and everything you needed. The place was clean and the set up was great! Walking distance to the train station, buses, and a laundromat. I would definitely return to their Airbnb and recommend their place to other travelers. Thank you!
ベッドがふかふかで寝やすかったです！

Elida is an excellent host. She took care of my daughter and me as if we were her family. Our rooms were wonderful and she made us feel so welcome. If you are looking for a restful excellent room in the Bronx, Elida's house is the place to go.
It’s a place to stay. Great location and responsive host.

Chang’s place was just as described. Just what I needed for my one night stay! And they left snacks which was really nice. If you’re a solo traveler, please keep your check-in details on your body at all times.
Very well located, very quiet, very clean and convenient home.

The place was great, clean and welcoming. We enjoyed the possibility to cook some meals there, especially in the morning. The metro station was very close by, so it was easy to travel around the city. And thanks to the host, if anything was needed, he was very responsive. Thank you!
The apartment was very clean and noise free. Jozef was very communicative and any issues he would fix the same day or next day. Overall,  Jozef was a kind host.

Cris est venu nous accueillir en personne.
C'est un homme agréable, discret et très réactif. Que se soit à Harlem ou le centre ville ses connaissances sont variées et de qualité (restaurants, épiceries, ...).
La maison de style New-Yorkais nous a apporté un dépaysement total. Elle est spacieuse, propre et après des journées en centre ville, vous avons trouvé calme et repos. En août, nos soirées rooftop étaient formidables. Proche métro.
Tout était parfait !
Merci Cris, nous rentrons en France avec de beaux souvenirs.
Fred, Yan et Hao Yuan.
Not too bad neighborhood cannot walk in safe there's a guy nearby had a pitbull dangerous

The location is a beautiful, walkable neighborhood very close to the bus stop for a short 20-minute bus ride to the Staten Island Ferry into Manhattan. The apartment was immaculately clean, very nicely furnished, and provided everything needed to enjoy the stay including a washer/dryer and dishwasher!
Wonderful spot in the city with an amazing garden in the back

Nice, clean, and modern apartment.
Lucelia was very helpful.
She even helped me with my laundry.
And the spot is located in a very fun neighborhood: Jackson Heights.
Great stay here. Good size, tastefully decorated, good facilitates. Good bed in main bedroom. Windows could do with a little clean on the outside 😬 but excellent all round.

Great stay in the Bronx! I was able to be there comfortably for a month with a well equipped kitchen, laundry in the house, great heaters, and easily walkable to work. Daryl was proactive and responsive to all concerns which made the stay very easy.
Great place, in the heart of Jamaica Queens, great area, right next to the E train. Great host.

amazing home in the bronx. leaving today after ten days with my husband and kids. beds are so comfy so much space and family dining room was our personsal favourite. mike and his family made us so welcome with excellent communication throughout. great transport links especially 170 sub. i loved a coffee with my morninh view of the park.
Great stay, comfortable bed, perfect location!

Place was amazing! Had all the necessities I needed and the space was clean. Host was also very responsive which I appreciated. Also located close to a bus stop to get around easily. The only downside for me was that the bed was a little too firm so I couldn’t sleep that well, however that’s just my preference. Other than that, I loved it here :)
Julio was very friendly and helpful in getting around town.
Amy is a great host and very communicative! I had a lovely stay here. The neighborhood area was quiet and lovely to walk around during the day. Definitely a place to come back!
